content: चोदना .²1 Sending, directing, throwing. .²2 Urging or driving onward; ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं परिज्ञाता त्रिविधा कर्मचोदना <ls>Bg.</ls> .²3 Prompting, inciting, encouraging, inspiration. .²4 A precept, sacred commandment, scriptural injunction. .²5 The category called अपूर्व (in पूर्वमीमांसा); चोदनेत्यपूर्वं ब्रूमः <ls>ŚB. on MS. 7. 1. 7</ls>.
